create_baseclient_instance: create a BaseClient instance with a specified client type string for simulation
switch_client_mode: switch the BaseClient running mode between CONFIGURATION and SIMULATION using switch_mode
check_client_mode: check the current client mode of a BaseClient via the client_mode property
assert_configuration_mode: assert the BaseClient is in configuration mode before performing setup operations
use_clienttype_enum: use the ClientType enum to reference BULLET as the pybullet client type
